svg.title: Four fires, four toxic plumes over a Nanterre housing estate
svg.desc: Illustrative map of the streets around the Tours Aillaud in Nanterre with four riot fires - a tire barricade, a torched car, a burning EV and a plastic dumpster - and their smoke carried northeast by a southwest wind, with the carcinogens and poisons each releases.
svg.text: Illustrative riot-night scenario on the real street plan
around the Tours Aillaud, with a southwest wind
Hover or tap a fire to isolate its plume and its 300 m reach
Ring: 50 m acute-exposure zone. Shading: smoke
carried downwind, fading out by 300 m.
positions and wind are illustrative, not a recorded night.
The 50 m and 300 m zones are the article's estimates;
plume shapes follow standard Gaussian dispersion, not
